positive.prompt: Interview me about what I actually want before you build anything
Grill me on the requirements, the ask is fuzzy
Ask me one question at a time until you understand the feature
Interview me about my design brief and sketches to clarify unresolved requirements before building

negative.prompt: Run the full test suite and report failures
Deploy the current build to staging

evals.prompt: I want 'a better admin page'. Interview me before proposing anything.
evals.expected_output: A one-question-at-a-time interview that converges on validated requirements
expectations: Questions are asked one at a time, not in batches
The agent does not propose solutions before understanding the need
The interview surfaces the underlying goal behind the stated ask

evals.prompt: I have drawn a Voyager dock on an ordinary terminal. I want you to grill me on this design before we build. The brief says docking registers an existing terminal, and I want to choose whether voice starts automatically. Reflect what you understand and ask the next design question. Do not implement or choose my preference for me.
evals.expected_output: An existing-brief design interview that preserves the ordinary-terminal requirement and asks one unresolved decision with a reasoned recommendation.
expectations: The agent reflects the supplied brief rather than restarting with generic project discovery
The next question targets an unresolved design decision, one at a time
An agent recommendation is labelled as a proposal rather than an already agreed requirement
The agent neither implements the feature nor claims feasibility from the design sketch
